claims: The exact frozen build-10 archive passed the four-component signed-archive inspection before distribution.
Xcode Organizer produced an automatic Cloud Managed Apple Distribution export for App Store Connect with version/build management disabled, preserving WellSpent 0.2.0 (10).

The distribution-export inspection passed for the phone app, phone widget, Watch app and Watch widget, including bundle topology, versions, architectures, strict signatures, source-reconciled entitlements and privacy manifests, unexpired App Store profiles, dSYMs, compiled icon renditions and fixture isolation.

The exact inspected IPA SHA256 is d23bda44b8d3e908886e8cf6b54c105e79f787b6aceeb826ac8ed1a096bd821d and the exported product-file manifest SHA256 is 05b4d5ae0c636953a9a98331ef571622b66adb64146564c42f2436aa7deb12b9.
Xcode Organizer separately reported that WellSpent 0.2.0 (10) uploaded successfully; App Store processing and review submission remain external-service evidence.
limitations: This signed-package receipt does not substitute for App Store processing, build attachment, App Review submission, physical-device acceptance or public release.
The earlier command-line export failure and post-upload package mismatch remain preserved as separate diagnostics; they are not relabeled by this successful automatic local export.
Public release remains manual and is not approved by this receipt.
